check.reason: Melian shares none of this text, which the reviewing host's store and terminal hold

message.text: The new placement tests exercise closing newlines but never a truncated revision read. No test in compare.test.ts would fail with the line-362 LogicalOperator mutant (`read.truncated && lines.at(-1) === ""`) applied.

explanation.what: The new placement tests exercise closing newlines but never a truncated revision read. No test in compare.test.ts would fail with the line-362 LogicalOperator mutant (`read.truncated && lines.at(-1) === ""`) applied.
explanation.whatToDo: Add a changed file exceeding the revision byte limit, with the cutoff inside a line, and assert that a valid miss on that partial line is skipped while a miss on the preceding complete line is exported.
explanation.whyHere: That mutation retains a partial final line when the 8 MiB read cuts mid-line, exporting a miss the measurement tool cannot place and thereby invalidating the misses file.

properties.failureScenario: Create a changed text file consisting of `x\n` followed by more than 8 MiB of `a` characters, and adjudicate misses on lines 1 and 2 valid. The read is truncated mid-line 2. With the LogicalOperator mutant on line 362, line 2 is retained and both misses are exported instead of skipping line 2. The existing short-file tests never set read.truncated, so they do not distinguish this mutation.
